reviews.evidence: The patch only replaces an example comment in Material's snack-bar.md. This package does not contain that markdown or the snack-bar-annotated-component example.

The patch removes the word either from Material's input.md. The sentence still says an error shows when the control is invalid and touched, or the parent form is submitted. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch renames the documented range-thumb selectors in Material's slider.md and says the start thumb cannot exceed the end thumb. This package has neither that markdown nor matSliderStartThumb.

The patch changes the documented Page Up step from 10 steps to 10% of max. The owned legacy slider still calls _increment(10), which adds step times 10. The markdown is not in this package, and this review does not change that behavior.
The patch tells readers to install the date-fns, Luxon, and Moment adapters with ng add. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch deletes a docs sentence that told chip users to announce removal with LiveAnnouncer. This package does not contain that markdown, and the owned chip sources do not mention LiveAnnouncer.
The patch adds Material Symbols guidance and switches the upstream dev-app font class. This package does not contain the dev-app or icon.md.
The patch inserts the word is in CDK scrolling.md. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch replaces the MDC progress-bar setup guide with a link to the public docs. This package does not contain that README.
The patch moves value="1.5" from mat-slider onto the inner input in slider.md. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch removes platform-browser-dynamic from upstream example Bazel targets. The only added line is an input target on the sidenav example. This package has no Bazel example graph.
The patch updates expansion examples to current MatExpansionModule, OnPush, and viewChild, plus expansion.md. Those example files are not in this package.
The patch refreshes button-toggle examples, including hide-selection-indicator checkboxes, and button-toggle.md. Those files are not in this package.
The patch rewords tooltip.md. It still documents below as the default position, before/after for RTL, a 1500ms mobile hide, and aria-describedby. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch edits toolbar examples, the upstream toolbar demo, and toolbar.md. This package does not contain those files.
The patch adds one sentence to table.md telling readers to update MatTableDataSource.data instead of recreating the source. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch adds a multiTemplateDataRows table example and wires it into the upstream table demo and table.md. Those files are not in this package.
The patch adds reactive and template form chip examples that use mat-chip-grid and mat-chip-row, and links them from chips.md. Those files are not in this package.

The patch renames the chips.md example comments from chips-template-form-example and chips-reactive-form-example to chips-template-form and chips-reactive-form. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch replaces MatLegacyProgressSpinner with MatProgressSpinner in upstream progress-spinner.md. This package does not contain that markdown, and the owned class name was not changed.
The patch documents childrenAccessor on the current tree and adds flat and nested examples. This package has no childrenAccessor and does not contain those files.
The patch adds a datepicker.md sentence saying MatDatepickerToggle is required for mobile screen readers. This package does not contain that markdown, and no runtime requirement was added.
The patch changes a form-field.md link from mat-chip-list to mat-chip-set. The owned chip list selector in legacy-chips/chip-list.ts is still mat-chip-list.
The patch adds a 48 by 48 touch-target recommendation to button.md. This package does not contain that markdown, and no button size was changed.
The patch migrates upstream testing Bazel targets from ts_library to ts_project and adds node_modules deps. It does not change component source. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch removes a repeated instead from autocomplete.md. The requireSelection sentence is otherwise unchanged. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch continues the upstream ts_library to ts_project migration and adds Bazel tsconfig files for the universal app and tests. No component source is in the diff. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch changes 26 Bazel files from ts_library to ts_project and sets symlink_prefix to dist/. No component source is in the diff. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch prepares an ng_project trial in cdk/a11y. Its compiler-cli patch drops the rootDir branch of the import strategy. This package does not vendor that patch or the Bazel graph.
The patch migrates ng_module targets to ng_project. The non-Bazel edits add type references to examples and the dev-app and delete localize-types.d.ts. Those files are not in this package.
The patch deletes an ng_module postinstall patch and retargets the remaining Bazel patch from @angular/bazel to rules_angular. This package does not carry those patches.
The patch removes interop_deps from 276 Bazel files and changes the docs highlighter from require('highlight.js') to an import. This package has neither file.

The patch splits Bazel targets and moves a localize import into the dev-app polyfills, adds an esbuild config, and drops a chromedriver env assignment from an e2e spec. Those files are not in this package.
The patch renames karma_web_test_suite to ng_web_test_suite in seven upstream BUILD files. No component source is in the diff. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch merges defaults2.bzl back into defaults.bzl across 307 Bazel files. The load path changes from //tools:defaults2.bzl to //tools:defaults.bzl. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch inserts a blank line before the button variants table in button.md so the table renders. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch adds fab_theme and icon_button_theme to the button Bazel theme srcs. This package has no Bazel graph.
The patch documents matContextMenuTriggerFor and adds a right-click menu example. This package has no matContextMenuTriggerFor and does not contain those files.
The patch renames the documented selector cdkNodeDef to cdkTreeNodeDef in the CDK and Material tree guides. This package does not contain those guides or that selector.
The patch removes @angular/animations from six upstream BUILD files. This package still uses animations for the historical specs, and it has no Bazel graph.
The patch enables strict deps on ts_project targets. The only source edit removes a trailing slash from an import in cdk-experimental accordion. That file is not in this package.
The patch switches upstream datepicker examples to the Luxon adapter and adds Luxon Bazel deps. Those examples are not in this package.
The patch deletes the note that FocusMonitor emits outside the Angular zone. This package does not contain that markdown, and no focus-monitor code was changed.
The patch says to import MatAutocompleteModule before MatChipsModule so keyboard selection does not also add the typed text. Those files are not in this package.
The patch updates the ARIA tabs link from the 1.1 practices URL to the APG tabs pattern. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch adds virtual-scroll table examples and documents escaped column class names. Those files are not in this package.
The patch moves drag-and-drop examples into separate packages and says automatic scrolling needs cdkScrollable. Those files are not in this package.
The patch updates upstream docs Karma configs for Jasmine 6. This package was not bumped to Jasmine 6 by this review.
The patch rewrites remaining NgModule provider examples as bootstrapApplication calls, including FullscreenOverlayContainer. This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch changes dialog, snack-bar, and bottom-sheet examples from constructor injection to inject(). Those markdown files are not in this package.
The patch tells readers to import CdkTrapFocus and to call inject(LiveAnnouncer). This package does not contain that markdown.
The patch replaces remaining NgModule prose with standalone import instructions. Those markdown files are not in this package.
The patch documents matButtonIcon and iconPositionEnd. This package does not contain that markdown or those attributes.

The patch says DEFAULT_DIALOG_CONFIG and MAT_DIALOG_DEFAULT_OPTIONS replace built-in defaults, while dialog.open merges a per-dialog config on top. The owned dialog already spreads the provided defaults and then the open config. The markdown is not in this package, and the code was not changed.
The patch changes the form-field chip link from mat-chip-set to mat-chip-grid. The owned chip list selector is still mat-chip-list.
The patch adds a toolbar navigation-bar example. Those files are not in this package.
The patch adds a signal-form example that binds formField on mat-button-toggle-group. Those files are not in this package.
The patch tells authors to label static prefixes and suffixes for screen readers. This package does not contain that markdown, and no prefix markup was changed.
The patch adds a signal-form error example for matInput. Those files are not in this package.
The patch adds FormField to the radio and slide-toggle forms sections. Those markdown files are not in this package.
The patch adds signal-form examples for checkbox and chips. Those examples are not in this package.
The patch adds FormField to the forms sections of autocomplete, datepicker, list, select, slider, and timepicker. Those markdown files are not in this package.
